caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of lace framed by a simple brown wood-like border. The lace features a repeating pattern of cream-colored flowers and leaves, arranged in a dense, interlocking design, with all elements outlined or bordered in shades of burgundy and brown. The background behind the lace is a muted red, which contrasts with the lighter creamed-colored lacework. There is a horizontal band near the top of the lace with a more linear and organized arrangement of leaf and floral motifs, separated from the main area by a fine striped band. The drawing is set onto an off-white page, bordered by a thin red line that runs parallel to the edges of the paper. In the lower right corner of the page, there is small, neat, handwritten text.
title: Paper Fire Grate Cover
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
